target: Ableton Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (2026-07-07_e3d8be4d07) / macOS (arm64 and x86_64 builds)

partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-001: Song clock: samples per beat (SR / T) x 60 and beats per sample in binary64; song beat at render sample n from the anchor; anchors at Play, Continue and song-loop jumps; results independent of buffer size
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-002: Placement of a beat event on render sample P(b), or on P(b) or P(b) + 1 where the exact position is an integer and the binary64 product exceeds it; at one beat, note-off before a clip's loop wrap before note-on
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-003: The song tempo is used as its binary32 value (tempos 90 to 140 BPM in the cases)
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-004: Play from stopped with a stated start beat: rounded to the lattice, a negative value raised to 0, the start beat plays on render sample 0
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-005: Stop holds the song beat of its request sample; Continue resumes from it with a new anchor
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-006: Song loop: length used as at least 1 beat; jump to the loop start where the song beat reaches the loop end, placed by the placement rule, with a new anchor; no jump when Play starts at or after the loop end; a playing session clip is not moved by a jump
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-007: Launch-button press: a quantized launch with no explicit time and fire velocity 1; grid from the clip's own value (2 to 14, clip signature), Global (the set's global value, song signature) or None; grid lengths of global values 1 to 13
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-008: Press beat; launch boundary B by the stated arithmetic; pre-delay 0 on a MIDI track and on an audio track with no clip playing
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-009: With pre-delay 0 the launch takes effect at B and the clip's start plays at B
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-010: No grid: the clip's start is the lattice-rounded press beat; launch while stopped with start beat 0 starts the transport and the clip on render sample 0
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-011: Warped session MIDI clip: start, loop start and end, loop switch; clip time; passes; song beat of each note in each pass; end of an unlooped clip
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-012: Note-on at Time with its Velocity unrounded; note-off at the rounded Time + Duration with OffVelocity; zero-length notes; disabled notes not sent
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-013: A note starts only inside a pass; a note under way at the clip's start is not started; a note-on at the loop end never plays; a note-off at the loop end is sent with its own velocity before the wrap
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-014: With loop start 0, a note held across the loop end is cut at the wrap with velocity 64; a note sounding at an unlooped clip's end gets velocity 64 there
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-015: With VelocityAmount 0, VelocityDeviation 0, Probability 1 and no groove, the stored velocity is sent unchanged, at the stored times, and every enabled note plays
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-017: Unwarped session audio clip: region in seconds; transposition; read step in 32.32 fixed point; first frame from LoopStart with fraction 0; output k reads first frame + k x step; output 0 on the launch sample
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-018: Direct copy for a step of exactly 1 whatever HiQ says; linear interpolation in binary32 with HiQ off
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-019: SampleVolume gain and its limits; a mono file on both channels; 16-bit PCM frames as int16 / 32768
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-020: Fade off: no fade; past the file's last frame the output is silence

compatibility_dimensions.timing: render sample of note events, launches and audio clip starts; extracted-execution arithmetic and static-derived expectations; reference execution not-run
compatibility_dimensions.audio: unwarped clip signal before devices and mixer: direct copy, linear interpolation and gain; reference execution not-run
compatibility_dimensions.behavior: transport, launch and note emission as listed; everything else excluded
compatibility_dimensions.project-files: the fixtures must open; values after opening and saving not graded

expectation_provenance_labels.extracted-execution arithmetic (x86_64 b: the arithmetic that gives each listed sample or value (clock, placement, Stop and Continue, song loop, launch boundary, clip position, note events, read step, kernels, gain) equals the original x86_64 code's results on the runs made; that playback reaches it with the case's values is static-derived
expectation_provenance_labels.static-derived; not observed reference o: derived from static evidence about the pinned build

stated_assumptions.AS-1: The macOS arm64 build follows the rules that were run on, or derived only from, the x86_64 build: the clock and launch arithmetic, the note order at one beat, the song beat of a note in a clip's first pass, which notes start or are cut in a pass, the note velocity path, the read step, the interpolation kernels (within the linear tolerance) and silence past the file's end.
stated_assumptions.AS-2: An audio clip's stored IsWarped, HiQ, Fade, SampleVolume, PitchCoarse and PitchFine are the values its playback uses, and a session clip never starts in a crossfade.
stated_assumptions.AS-3: While a set is open, the global launch quantization in effect is the stored GlobalQuantisation.
stated_assumptions.AS-4: In a set whose time signature never changes, launch grid lines lie at whole multiples of the grid length from song beat 0.
stated_assumptions.AS-5: For a transposition other than 0 and for the clip gain, the macOS C library gives the binary32 power and the decibel-to-gain values that the x86_64 runs got from glibc: the step and gain values stated in the cases.

unreleased_requirements.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-021: an unwarped clip's end sample and its independence of tempo (with Fade false its end is not visible in the clip signal)
unreleased_requirements.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-022: clip stop buttons, Stop All Clips, empty-slot presses and quantized stops
unreleased_requirements.REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-023: clips after a transport Stop and a new Play

without_expectation: which start beat the original's own Play control uses after opening, what its transport controls do, and which gestures other than the launch button reach the launch path
which of P(b) and P(b) + 1 occurs where both are listed
tempo changes; the tempo limits; a second Stop; Play after Stop; Stop or Continue while a clip plays
the song loop switched or changed during playback; a loop start below 0; a launch whose boundary is at or after the loop end; any event on the beat of a jump; a launch on the beat of a note event
the launch sample and the audio during a crossfade between audio clips (pre-delay above 0); a launch on a track whose clip is playing
note chasing; extra messages at a transport Stop; retriggered notes; the cut velocity when the loop does not start at 0

notes overlapping another note of the same key, two notes at one time on a key, a zero-length note followed by a note at the same time, and probability groups; VelocityAmount, VelocityDeviation or Probability other than 0, 0 and 1; MIDI clips with IsWarped false
LaunchQuantisation outside 0 to 14 and GlobalQuantisation outside 0 to 13; launch modes other than Trigger; legato

audio clips with Fade true, HiQ true with a step other than exactly 1, StartRelative other than 0, LoopOn true, warping on, PitchFine other than 0 or a transposition other than 0 and 12; files other than 16-bit PCM mono WAV; a region shorter than the frames that remain after the first frame; fade values; the interpolated outputs next to the file's last frame

set content other than the fixtures' form (spec.md preconditions): more than one track, scene or clip, devices, return or group tracks, automation beyond the one-event tempo and time-signature envelopes, enabled follow actions

value_tolerance.timing: exact render sample, or either of two listed samples (REQ-PLAYBACK-CORE-002)
value_tolerance.gain: relative 2.4e-7 (gain within 1.2e-7 relative plus one binary32 rounding)
value_tolerance.linear: absolute per window: 2 binary32 units in the last place of the largest frame magnitude that the window reads

render_conventions: render sample 0 is the first sample after the script's first Play, or its first launch while stopped
each action is handled at its stated render sample; actions at one sample in script order
a render starts from a settled state: every ramp the loaded state starts has finished before render sample 0
these conventions define the test vehicle; they describe no behavior of the original
fixture_origin: independently generated minimal Live Sets (one track, one scene, one clip) and two generated 16-bit mono WAV files; no shipped file, schema content or program code
